join in: take part in something a group is doing
typical: join in (sth), join in the fun/conversation. NOT for: watching.
The whole village joined in the fun.
He laughed and Mattie joined in.
jot down: write a short piece of information quickly
typical: jot sth down, jot down a number/an idea. NOT for: typing a report.
Let me jot down your number.
I jotted down a few ideas.
jump in: interrupt someone or suddenly join a conversation
typical: jump in (with sth). NOT for: waiting.
Lena jumped in with a remark.
He jumped in before I'd finished.
begin to do something quickly without thinking much
typical: jump in (with both feet). NOT for: planning.
Don't just jump in; plan first.
She jumped in and bought it.
get into a car or water quickly
typical: jump in (a car/the pool). NOT for: jumping out.
Jump in! I'll give you a lift.
The kids jumped in the pool.
